mira: quick update — we closed $10M ARR today!! :tada: :sparkles:

ops-bot: milestone logged: revenue.arr -> 10000000 (event id: m-1946504321)
anika: idea: 3pm seltzer cart + 'shelfie' wall in kitchen + plant adoption table? who’s in?

ellie: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-llm-xyz :party_parrot:

anika: setting up a quick sign-up so we don’t run out of plants: https://forms.gle/plant-pickup123 (placeholder)
ops-bot: calendar: kitchen reserved at 15:00 by mira. Event created.

mira: plan = 3:00 seltzer + stickers + shelfie wall. 3:15 tiny toast in kitchen + mirror on #random-video-call for remote.
devon: virtual toast: i’ll cue a 45s hype montage :grin: :clapper:
sam: we should take a team shelfie and pin it on the lobby board. caption: "Ten Million, One Tiny Ficus"

ellie: 1

mira: thank you team. feeling grateful. quick shoutout: infra on the late-night scaling fixes, sales for the deal, and everyone for the product polish ❤️ :confetti_ball:
